issue_operational_impacts.guest_email_not_invited: An active guest may not receive the calendar invite, StreamYard logistics, or live-show timing updates.
issue_operational_impacts.active_guest_email_missing: The operator cannot verify whether the active guest has been invited without manually confirming the correct email.
issue_operational_impacts.title_missing_guest: Operators may overlook a booked guest when preparing title cards, promotion copy, speaker tagging, or show notes.
issue_operational_impacts.guest_not_represented: The guest is invited, but production context may be incomplete for downstream operators reviewing the calendar event.
issue_operational_impacts.required_attendee_not_invited: A required internal operator may miss production prep, calendar updates, or day-of coordination.
issue_operational_impacts.pr_email_not_invited: A PR or assistant contact may miss coordination details if they are expected to support the guest.
issue_operational_impacts.sop_required_assets_missing: The event may be missing a production asset such as StreamYard logistics, promotion links, or final show instructions.
issue_operational_impacts.required_custom_fields_missing_from_desc: Important booking details may not be visible in the operator-facing calendar event.
issue_operational_impacts.form_submission_not_exactly_linked: The audit cannot prove the calendar description came from the exact HighLevel submission, so edits should be human-reviewed.
issue_operational_impacts.booking_without_calendar_event: A booked episode may not have an operator-facing calendar event, which can cause the show to be missed operationally.
issue_operational_impacts.calendar_export_window_gap: The audit cannot prove whether a Google Calendar event exists because the loaded calendar export does not cover the HighLevel booking time.
issue_operational_impacts.calendar_event_without_booking: A calendar event may be stale, manually created, or disconnected from the active booking source of truth.
issue_operational_impacts.calendar_event_needs_confirmation: A calendar event may still be valid, but the related HighLevel context is canceled or mismatched and needs human confirmation.
issue_operational_impacts.linkedin_event_exists_calendar_needs_upd: The LinkedIn event already exists, but operators may miss it until the Google Calendar event is updated with the URL and downstream SOP steps are completed.
issue_operational_impacts.pr_representative_booking_guest_represen: A PR representative, assistant, or submitter appears to have booked on behalf of the actual guest, and the guest is represented by other booking/calendar evidence.
issue_operational_impacts.guest_topics_pending: The episode cannot move into final LinkedIn, calendar-description, or email prep until guest topics are received.
issue_operational_impacts.guest_confirmation_pitch_follow_up: The guest or booking status needs human confirmation before the episode can be treated as production-ready.
issue_operational_impacts.guest_rsvp_acceptance_risk: Guest-side attendees may not have accepted the calendar invite, creating confirmation risk before production.
issue_operational_impacts.duplicate_calendar_event: Duplicate calendar events can split attendee lists and cause operators or guests to follow the wrong invite.
issue_operational_impacts.calendar_missing_preshow_block: The calendar may not reserve prep time before going live.
issue_operational_impacts.date_time_mismatch: Guests and operators may arrive at different times if HighLevel and Google Calendar disagree.
issue_operational_impacts.calendar_end_time_mismatch: The calendar may reserve too little or too much production time.
issue_operational_impacts.attendee_list_unavailable: The audit cannot verify guest, PR, assistant, or internal invite coverage without attendee data.
issue_operational_impacts.assistant_email_present: Assistant or alternate attendees may be intentional, but the operator should know they are present.
issue_operational_impacts.default: This can create manual production risk unless an operator verifies it before showtime.

confidence_explanations.high: The audit is based on direct normalized HighLevel and Google Calendar evidence.
confidence_explanations.medium: The audit found a likely issue, but one or more source links, submission matches, or SOP fields require human review.
confidence_explanations.low: The audit cannot verify the item from normalized data and needs manual operator review.
confidence_explanations.form_submission_not_exactly_linked: Discovery could not prove the exact HighLevel form submission ID for this guest or episode.
confidence_explanations.sop_required_assets_missing: The audit can identify configured missing text/assets, but the operator may need to confirm whether an alternate asset location is acceptable.
confidence_explanations.default: Confidence is based on the available normalized audit evidence.

operator_recommendation_rules.critical_reason: Critical issues can block a successful show and should be reviewed today.
operator_recommendation_rules.warning_due_reason: This Warning affects an upcoming episode inside the configured action window.
operator_recommendation_rules.warning_monitor_reason: This Warning is outside the configured immediate action window and should be monitored.
operator_recommendation_rules.informational_reason: Informational findings do not require immediate action but should stay visible.

guest_email_not_invited.reason: Adding a guest to Google Calendar is a write action and must be approved by an operator.

active_guest_email_missing.reason: The system cannot infer a missing guest email safely.

title_missing_guest.reason: Renaming a calendar event is a write action and should be approved because titles affect guests and operators.

required_attendee_not_invited.reason: Adding internal attendees is a write action and should require approval.

sop_required_assets_missing.reason: Adding SOP links or production assets can affect guest-facing instructions and should be reviewed.

form_submission_not_exactly_linked.reason: Uncertain source linkage should not trigger automated edits.

duplicate_calendar_event.reason: Resolving duplicates requires human judgment about the authoritative event.

calendar_export_window_gap.reason: This is a data coverage issue; the safe action is to extend the read-only export window and rerun the audit.

calendar_event_without_booking.reason: A calendar event without a booking may be intentional and should not be deleted or changed automatically.

calendar_event_needs_confirmation.reason: Confirmation requires human judgment across HighLevel and Google Calendar.

guest_topics_pending.reason: The system cannot invent guest topics or safely send production emails before topics are received.

guest_confirmation_pitch_follow_up.reason: Guest confirmation and pitch follow-up require human outreach and judgment.

guest_rsvp_acceptance_risk.reason: RSVP follow-up requires human judgment and may involve external outreach.

default.what_jessie_should_verify: Review the HighLevel and Google Calendar evidence before taking any external action.
default.approval_required_before_action: Human approval is required before any external system is changed.
